name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
description: A voluntary framework organized around four functions — Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage — that helps organizations identify, assess, and manage risks across the AI system lifecycle.
contentStatusNotice: Function and category identifiers and titles are drawn from the public NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1). Purpose, summary, and review guidance are application-authored to support compliance review workflows and are not official NIST guidance.
